original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 upgraded Pebble, the ACME test server used by its own end-to-end tests, to v2.7.0 and adjusted those tests to match the latest Pebble behavior; the change is confined to the test suite and has no operational consequence for cert-manager deployments.

decision.reason: [ev-ea4a77b80f71] says Pebble was upgraded to v2.7.0 for cert-manager's own ACME E2E tests, and the release notes list it under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". It does not say that cert-manager deployments now depend on Pebble or need a particular Pebble version. A product-relationship requirement-changed assertion would wrongly treat a test-tool upgrade as a version requirement for customers. Its 'after' value "2.7.0" is also not a semver constraint. No subject family describes this test-only change, so no corrected assertion follows from the evidence.
